turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it bad to drink coffee in the afternoon?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a lot of people, yes. Caffeine can stay in your system for six hours or more, so a cup at four can still keep you up at ten.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll give it a shot tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat keeps scratching the furniture and I'm trying to pick a fix.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are several, um, possibilities, and I'd rather go through the whole lot first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a really tall scratching post right next to the couch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is putting sticky tape on the arms of the sofa so she hates touching it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could get those soft caps that go over her claws, which last about a month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Have you tried a scratching post before? If not, I'd start with the tall post plus the tape for a few weeks. If she ignores the post completely, the claw caps are a good backup.
